about: Mutants of compiler/check/diag, the self-hosted checker's diagnostics (capstone S3, unit S3-DIAG). The agreement with the Go checker over the corpus, the negative fixtures and the seeded perturbations (TestCompilerUnusedAgreesWithChecker) kills each.

mutants.name: unused-read-ignored
mutants.rule: A local that a row reads is not unused.

mutants.name: unused-param-reported
mutants.rule: A parameter is read by its callers: never an unused local, of a declaration, of a function literal a let holds, or of a function type in a pattern's type argument.

mutants.name: unused-case-binding-reported
mutants.from:
case ArmName:
			arm + "write _ in its place" + tail
mutants.to:
case ArmName:
			"\(name) is declared and not used"
mutants.rule: A case's or a catch arm's binding has its own message (read nowhere in its arm), not the local's.

mutants.name: unused-let-skipped
mutants.rule: An unread let is an unused local.

mutants.name: unused-import-package-wide
mutants.rule: An import reaches only its own file: a read in another file of the package does not use it.

mutants.name: unused-missing-import-reported
mutants.rule: An import no package answers has its own diagnostic and counts as read.

mutants.name: unused-refused-alias-reported
mutants.rule: An import alias with no name clash is refused (S108) and counts as read.

mutants.name: unused-alias-clash-ignored
mutants.rule: An alias whose path's name is a package-level declaration's is needed: unread, it is an unused import.

mutants.name: unused-alias-at-path
mutants.rule: A named import is reported at its name (ImportSpec.Pos).

mutants.name: unused-unsorted
mutants.rule: Diagnostics are in the Go checker's order: by file, then offset (an import before a later local).

mutants.name: unused-message
mutants.rule: The message is the Go checker's text.

mutants.name: before-ignores-offset
mutants.rule: Within a file the order is by offset first.

mutants.name: arm-binding-skipped
mutants.from:
case ArmName:
			arm + "write _ in its place" + tail
mutants.rule: An arm's binding that its arm never reads is S110.

mutants.name: arm-as-message
mutants.rule: An as-pattern's name says drop `as NAME`.

mutants.name: catch-rest-message
mutants.from: return if k == syntax.KCatchArm && from == n { CatchRest } else { ArmName }
mutants.rule: A catch arm's rest (case err:) says write case _.

mutants.name: arm-later-alternative-reported
mutants.rule: A case binds its names at its first pattern; a later pattern's names are the same binding.

mutants.name: arm-hint-dropped
mutants.rule: A capitalised binding's message says no type is so named.

mutants.name: arm-hint-lowercase
mutants.rule: Only a capitalised binding's message carries the hint.

mutants.name: as-in-arm-plain
mutants.from: named = named || syntax.AsPatternOf(t, id).Name == syntax.NodeAt(t, nrow)
mutants.to: named = named && syntax.AsPatternOf(t, id).Name == syntax.NodeAt(t, nrow)
mutants.rule: An as-pattern's name in an arm is the as binding, not a plain one.

mutants.name: own-call-mark-ignored
mutants.rule: A type parameter marked own admits a resource: [T own] checks clean (tparam-own).

mutants.name: own-caller-param-plain
mutants.rule: A value of the caller's own type parameter is a resource to an unmarked one (the walk's own mode).

mutants.name: own-closer-ignored
mutants.rule: A type of the package that implements Closer is a resource (R1).

mutants.name: own-record-fields-skipped
mutants.rule: A record holds a resource when a field does (R13).

mutants.name: own-union-variants-skipped
mutants.rule: A union holds a resource when a variant does (R13).

mutants.name: own-language-plain
mutants.rule: Option and Some of a resource hold it: a language type's parameter admits one with no mark.

mutants.name: own-instance-args-skipped
mutants.rule: An instance holds a resource when a type argument does (Box[Res], Some[Res]).

mutants.name: own-composite-skipped
mutants.from: if kind == store.KSlice || kind == store.KArray || kind == store.KMap || kind == store.KTuple || kind == store.KRowValue {
mutants.rule: A slice, array, Map or tuple holds a resource when an element (or key) does.

mutants.name: typemark-own-q-admitted
mutants.rule: A generic type's own parameter filled by an own type parameter is clean ([U own] Box[U]).

mutants.name: typemark-dropped
mutants.rule: A generic type's own parameter filled, in its package, by an unmarked type parameter is S108 (checkTypeMark).

mutants.name: typesite-unmarked-dropped
mutants.from: if text != "" && synHolds(s, k, res, p, infos, encl, a) {
mutants.rule: A resource as a written type argument of an unmarked parameter is S108, as at a call (Cell[Res]).

mutants.name: typesite-param-own-ignored
mutants.rule: An own type parameter written as an unmarked parameter's argument is S108 ([U own] Cell[U]).

mutants.name: typesite-map-plain
mutants.from: synHolds(s, k, res, p, infos, encl, mt.Key) || synHolds(s, k, res, p, infos, encl, mt.Value)
mutants.rule: Map[K, V] written as a type argument holds a resource when K or V does.

mutants.name: flow-join-maybe
mutants.from: out[i] = slot{st: stMaybe, at: y.at, how: y.how, loans: []loan{}}
mutants.to: out[i] = slot{st: stOwned, at: y.at, how: y.how, loans: []loan{}}
mutants.rule: Where a path that handed a value off meets one that did not, the value may be handed off (R21).

mutants.name: flow-move-recorded
mutants.from: w.st.slots[i] = slot{st: stMoved, at: h.at, how: h.how, loans: w.st.slots[i].loans}
mutants.rule: A hand-off ends the value's owner on that path: a later use is refused (R15, R20).

mutants.name: flow-lent-param
mutants.rule: A parameter the function does not take is lent: handing it off is refused with the signature to write (R10, R17).

mutants.name: flow-nested-frame
mutants.rule: A block passed to a call cannot hand off a value of the enclosing function, which releases it (R4, R30).

mutants.name: flow-loan-conflict
mutants.from: loanConflict(w, ws, wk, wt, i, h)
mutants.rule: A value lent to a call still being evaluated cannot be handed off in the same call (R17).

mutants.name: flow-return-ends-path
mutants.from:
w.st = unreached()
		close(w, ws, wk, wt, first)
mutants.rule: A return ends its path: no state flows on from it.

mutants.name: flow-loop-fixpoint
mutants.rule: A loop body runs to its fixpoint: a hand-off in one iteration reaches the next (R20).

mutants.name: flow-catch-arm-path
mutants.rule: A catch's arm runs from the state where its call failed, after the operands.

mutants.name: flow-short-circuit
mutants.from: w.st = join(w, ws, wk, wt, w.st, skipped, len(w.vars))
mutants.to: w.st = join(w, ws, wk, wt, skipped, skipped, len(w.vars))
mutants.rule: The right operand of && or || may not run: its hand-offs are on one path (R21).

mutants.name: flow-discard
mutants.rule: A new resource no one binds is discarded (R42).

mutants.name: flow-pkg-let
mutants.rule: A package let that holds a resource has no owner to hand it off (R11, R15).

mutants.name: flow-provider-lent
mutants.from: eval(w, ws, wk, wt, v.Value, mMove, handAt(at(w, ws, wk, wt, v.Value), "the with owns it"))
mutants.to: eval(w, ws, wk, wt, v.Value, mLend, noHand())
mutants.rule: A with owns a new resource provider of an inline context entry its block needs: the provider moves into it (withProviders).

mutants.name: flow-conversion-lends
mutants.from:
let pt = ops[i]
	if !opType(*w, ws, pt) || !tracked
mutants.to:
let pt = ops[i]
	if true || !opType(*w, ws, pt) || !tracked
mutants.rule: A resource converted to an operation type that holds one moves into the interface value (R23).

mutants.name: flow-closer-embedding-ignored
mutants.rule: An operation type that embeds Closer ({ ..Closer }) has its Close: it holds a resource (implementsCloser).

mutants.name: flow-union-named-members-ignored
mutants.from:
let m = syntax.Item(p.Tree, it.Members, j)
								variants = variants.Append(headName(p, m))
mutants.rule: A union's members named by their types (Res | Empty) are its variants: one that holds a resource makes the union hold one.

mutants.name: flow-pattern-lends-subject
mutants.from: move(w, ws, wk, wt, si, subj, handAt(at(w, ws, wk, wt, subj), "the match pattern moves it"))
mutants.rule: A clause whose pattern binds a resource of an owned whole subject moves the subject into the binding (patternClauses).

mutants.name: flow-pattern-outer-frame-owned
mutants.rule: Only a subject this frame owns moves into a pattern's binding; an enclosing frame's is lent (subjectOwner).

mutants.name: own-prelude-option-plain
mutants.rule: In the prelude itself Option and Some are language types too: builtin.ergo's Take returns Option[V] of an own V with no S108.

mutants.name: flow-own-param-untracked
mutants.rule: A value of a type parameter marked own is tracked as a resource's is (types.md, Generics 9; mayHoldResource).

mutants.name: flow-own-site-unnamed
mutants.from:
if genericOnly(w, ws, wk, t) {
			let names
mutants.rule: A refusal of a value that holds a resource only through an own type parameter names the mark (ownSite).

mutants.name: flow-gap42-scope-silent
mutants.from:
release(w, ws, wk, wt, first)
	w.vars = w.vars[0:first]
mutants.rule: A value of an own T still owned at the end of its scope is refused: a generic body does not release one yet (#197 Gap 42).

mutants.name: flow-gap42-return-silent
mutants.from:
release(w, ws, wk, wt, w.first)
		w.st = unreached()
mutants.rule: A return leaves every scope of the frame: what it still owns of an own T is refused (#197 Gap 42).

mutants.name: flow-gap42-branch-silent
mutants.rule: A break or continue leaves the loop's scopes: what they still own of an own T is refused (#197 Gap 42).

mutants.name: flow-gap42-try-any-call
mutants.rule: Under a try only a call whose signature fails leaves the frame and releases what it owns (onFailure).

mutants.name: flow-gap42-try-silent
mutants.from:
} else if h.failed == 0 && w.tries > 0 && canFail {
		release(w, ws, wk, wt, w.first)
mutants.rule: A failing call under a try leaves the frame: what it still owns of an own T is refused (#197 Gap 42).

mutants.name: flow-tries-leak-into-block
mutants.rule: A function literal is a frame of its own: an enclosing try does not reach its calls.

mutants.name: flow-generic-discard-refused
mutants.rule: A generic body may drop a value of an own T a call makes: its release is its instance's (plan 1.3).

mutants.name: flow-span-multiline
mutants.rule: A diagnostic's span stays on its first line: an if or match is underlined at its header (check.go report).

mutants.name: own-mapkey-unchecked
mutants.rule: A map key type that may hold a resource, a resource or an own type parameter, is S112 (resources R40).

mutants.name: own-mapkey-uncomparable-param
mutants.rule: An own type parameter with no comparable constraint as a map key is not S112: the Go checker refuses it as not comparable.

mutants.name: flow-try-catch-rest-silent
mutants.from:
if partial && w.tries > 0 {
		for f in failing {
mutants.to:
if partial && w.tries < 0 {
		for f in failing {
mutants.rule: A try around a catch passes on what its arms do not handle: each such failure leaves the frame and releases what it owns (handlers.go Partial).

mutants.name: flow-provider-pkglet-silent
mutants.rule: A resource provider of a with's inline context read through an element of a package let is S108 at the provider: the let has no owner to hand it to the with (resources R11; withown.go).

mutants.name: flow-lent-element-moved
mutants.rule: A for-in's element of a slice, array or map local is lent from the container: handing it off is S108 (resources R35, Gap 36).

mutants.name: flow-range-binds-none
mutants.from:
if tracked(w, ws, wk, wt, ty) {
			out = out.Append(local{decl: dense.Index(d), name: textAt(p, id), lent: true,
mutants.to:
if false {
			out = out.Append(local{decl: dense.Index(d), name: textAt(p, id), lent: true,
mutants.rule: A for-in binds each element that holds a resource, lent from the container, in each iteration's scope.

mutants.name: flow-element-moved-silent
mutants.from:
if kind == syntax.KIndexExpr {
		let root = un(w, ws, wk, wt, syntax.IndexExprOf(p.Tree, x).X)
mutants.to:
if false {
		let root = un(w, ws, wk, wt, syntax.IndexExprOf(p.Tree, x).X)
mutants.rule: An element of a slice, array or map local cannot be handed off by index (resources R35, R36).

mutants.name: flow-field-moved-silent
mutants.from: } else if fieldPlace(w, ws, wk, wt, x) {
mutants.rule: A field of a record local cannot be moved out of its record (resources R39).

mutants.name: flow-with-lend-dropped
mutants.from: if withLent(w, ws, wk, wt, i, x) {
mutants.rule: resources R11, R28: a local a with lends to its block cannot be handed off or closed inside the block (withLent).
